info.title: SUtech Transport API
info.description: Generated from the front end's Zod schemas (npm run openapi). Fields are snake_case, times are ISO 8601 UTC, money is integer piasters, errors are { code, message }.

post.summary: Step 1 of sign-in for every role: texts a one-time code to the account's registered phone. Errors: UNKNOWN_IDENTIFIER (404), ACCOUNT_DISABLED (403), OTP_LOCKED (429), OTP_RATE_LIMITED (429).
Step 2: the same identifier plus the code. Returns a bearer token that carries the role. Errors: INVALID_OTP (400), OTP_EXPIRED (400), OTP_LOCKED (429).
Revokes the caller's token.

get.summary: The signed-in account and its role. 401 when the token has expired or was revoked.
Server health and current server time (UTC).
Lines open this term, with price, bus type, free seats and the first pickup time. Names follow Accept-Language.

One line with its stops in order (name, landmark note, morning pickup time, map pin) and its bus and driver. The driver's mobile is filled only for the line's active subscribers and their guardians; everyone else gets null. Errors: LINE_NOT_FOUND (404).
The student's subscription for the current term, or null if they have none. The server moves an unpaid reservation to expired (and frees the seat) once hold_expires_at passes.

post.summary: Books a seat on a line at one stop and holds it for 24 hours until a receipt arrives. The price is fixed now. Errors: SEAT_UNAVAILABLE (409), ALREADY_SUBSCRIBED (409), LINE_NOT_FOUND (404), STOP_NOT_ON_LINE (422).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.

post.summary: Cancels a reservation that is not paid yet and frees the seat (to pick another line or stop). Paid subscriptions go through a refund request instead. Errors: NOT_CANCELLABLE (409).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.

get.summary: Term price, the university's bank account (NBE) and the offices for paying by Visa. Office hours follow Accept-Language.
The student's receipts this term, oldest first, each with its review status.

post.summary: Uploads a bank deposit or transfer receipt for a reserved seat. The seat stays held while finance reviews it. Errors: HOLD_EXPIRED (409), NOT_AWAITING_PAYMENT (409), RECEIPT_ALREADY_USED (409), RECEIPT_TOO_LARGE (413), AMOUNT_MISMATCH (422).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.

get.summary: The active subscriber's digital pass with a fresh signed QR token (valid 30 seconds). The app calls it again just before the token expires. Errors: NOT_SUBSCRIBED (403).

The active subscriber's next trip: date, their stop and pickup time, the bus, and where the bus is now (from its GPS device). trip is null for students without an active subscription. Live changes arrive on the WebSocket as bus.location and trip.status.

Announcements for the caller, newest first: official notices for everyone, and delays or changes on the caller's own line. Optional `kind` filter. Text follows Accept-Language. Office staff see every line's. Published by the Transportation office (POST /admin/announcements); each new one also creates an `announcement` notification.

post.summary: The Transportation office posts an official notice or a service change, for everyone or one line, in Arabic and English. Each reader gets it in their language with an `announcement` notification (and Web Push). Logged in the audit log. Errors: LINE_NOT_FOUND (404).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.

get.summary: The student's line change, refund, complaint and model permit requests this term, newest first, each with its status history. Office notes follow Accept-Language.
The term's refund table, today's deduction (Cairo date) and the amount the student paid. From the server so the dates change each term without a new app.
One of the student's own requests. Another student's request answers 404.

post.summary: The university's line change form: new line and stop, permanent or temporary (with dates), the reason and the guardian's details. It starts as awaiting_guardian and reaches the office only once the guardian approves it in the app (the guardian's account is the phone on the student's file). Needs an active subscription. Errors: NO_ACTIVE_SUBSCRIPTION (409), REQUEST_ALREADY_OPEN (409), SAME_LINE (422), INVALID_DATES (422), LINE_NOT_FOUND (404), STOP_NOT_ON_LINE (422).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.

post.summary: Cancels the paid subscription and asks for a refund under the term's refund policy, with the guardian's approval. An ordinary refund is refused once the deduction reaches 100%; medical, bereavement and transfer cases are decided by the university and need documents. Errors: NO_ACTIVE_SUBSCRIPTION (409), REQUEST_ALREADY_OPEN (409), REFUND_WINDOW_CLOSED (422), DOCUMENTS_REQUIRED (422), RECEIPT_TOO_LARGE (413).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.

post.summary: A complaint to the Transportation office (driver, delay, bus condition, crowding, safety, payment, other), with optional photos. Payment complaints need a booking; the others an active subscription. Errors: NO_SUBSCRIPTION (409), NO_ACTIVE_SUBSCRIPTION (409), LINE_NOT_FOUND (404), INVALID_DATES (422), RECEIPT_TOO_LARGE (413).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.

post.summary: The university's safety permit to bring a project model onto the bus: material, size, purpose and destination, entry and exit date and time, the doctor or TA responsible, and the student's liability declaration. The server fills the student's details and the bus (their own line) from the account and subscription; the office adds the driver later. Signed by the doctor/TA, then the Safety department. Needs an active subscription. Errors: NO_ACTIVE_SUBSCRIPTION (409), REQUEST_ALREADY_OPEN (409), INVALID_DATES (422).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.

post.summary: The student takes back a request the office hasn't started on yet (awaiting_guardian or submitted). Errors: NOT_WITHDRAWABLE (409).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.

get.summary: The line change requests of this guardian's children this term, newest first: the ones waiting for the guardian (awaiting_guardian) and the ones already answered. A new one arrives as a notification. Names and notes follow Accept-Language.

post.summary: The guardian agrees to the child's line change: awaiting_guardian → submitted, and it goes to the Transportation office. The student is notified. Errors: NOT_YOUR_CHILD (403), NOT_AWAITING_GUARDIAN (409).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.

post.summary: The guardian doesn't agree: awaiting_guardian → rejected, with an optional note to the student. The office never sees it. Errors: NOT_YOUR_CHILD (403), NOT_AWAITING_GUARDIAN (409).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.

get.summary: The caller's notifications, newest first, with the unread count. New ones also arrive live as the `notification.new` event; the app re-reads this list when one comes in. Text follows Accept-Language.

post.summary: Marks every notification read. Returns the new unread count (0).
Marks one notification read (already read: no change). Returns the new unread count.

get.summary: The active subscriber's reported "not going" days from today on, and the next service days they can still report (7 days ahead, today until the bus leaves the line's first stop). Errors: NO_ACTIVE_SUBSCRIPTION (409).

post.summary: "Not going" for one service day (both trips). The driver, the supervisor, the guardian and the Transportation office are told, and the student is not marked absent that day. Errors: NO_ACTIVE_SUBSCRIPTION (409), DATE_NOT_REPORTABLE (422), ABSENCE_CUTOFF_PASSED (409), ALREADY_REPORTED (409).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.

post.summary: Takes back a "not going" report before the bus leaves the line's first stop; the same people are told the student is riding after all. Errors: ABSENCE_CUTOFF_PASSED (409).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.

get.summary: The student's trips this term, newest first: boarding and arrival scans, absences, "not going" days and check-outs with their reason, plus a count of each. Optional `outcome` filter. Text follows Accept-Language. Empty for a student who never rode.

Where the student's bus is now: latest GPS fix, the trail so far, ETA to their stop or to campus, and the bus and driver. trip is null with a reason when there's nothing to follow. Positions come from the GPS device installed in the bus. After the first read, follow the `bus.location` WebSocket event for that trip_id (the app re-reads this every 5 s until the WebSocket is in place).

The same live view for one of the guardian's children. Errors: NOT_YOUR_CHILD (403) for a student who isn't linked to this guardian. Positions come from the GPS device installed in the bus. After the first read, follow the `bus.location` WebSocket event for that trip_id (the app re-reads this every 5 s until the WebSocket is in place).
The students linked to this guardian (by the guardian's phone on the student's file), with each one's booking this term. Names follow Accept-Language.

Today for one child: where they are in the trip to campus (from the bus scans and its GPS), what happened so far, the bus and driver, and the last few days. Changes arrive live as `child.day` events (the app re-reads every 30 s until the WebSocket is in place). Errors: NOT_YOUR_CHILD (403).

The crew's day: their line, bus and stops, and today's trips (outbound, then return) with every subscriber's state (waiting, boarded, checked out, not going, absent), the counts, reported delays and the latest SOS. Errors: NO_ASSIGNMENT (404) when the account is on no bus today. Live changes arrive on the WebSocket as trip.status and attendance.event; until then the app re-reads it every 15 s.

post.summary: The crew starts the trip; this is how the server knows outbound from return. Students and guardians on the line are told the bus left. Errors: TRIP_ALREADY_STARTED (409), TRIP_ALREADY_ENDED (409), OTHER_TRIP_IN_PROGRESS (409). Driver or supervisor of this bus only; any other trip is NOT_YOUR_TRIP (403).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.

post.summary: The crew ends the trip. Business rule 6: every subscriber not scanned (and not "not going") becomes absent, and their guardian is told; riders on board are marked arrived. Errors: TRIP_NOT_STARTED (409), TRIP_ALREADY_ENDED (409). Driver or supervisor of this bus only; any other trip is NOT_YOUR_TRIP (403).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.

post.summary: Records a boarding or a mid-trip check-out. method qr sends the pass's QR text (signed, 30 s); manual sends the university ID when the student can't show the pass (logged as manual). A check-out needs a reason and tells the guardian at once (no approval). A "not going" student who rides anyway is boarded. Errors: TRIP_NOT_STARTED (409), TRIP_ALREADY_ENDED (409), CARD_INVALID (422), CARD_EXPIRED (422), STUDENT_NOT_FOUND (404), NOT_ON_THIS_TRIP (409), ALREADY_BOARDED (409), NOT_ON_BOARD (409), REASON_REQUIRED (422). Driver or supervisor of this bus only; any other trip is NOT_YOUR_TRIP (403).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.

post.summary: Reports a delay on today's trip. The server posts a delay announcement on the line and a bus_delayed notification to its students and guardians. Allowed before and during the trip. Errors: TRIP_ALREADY_ENDED (409). Driver or supervisor of this bus only; any other trip is NOT_YOUR_TRIP (403).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.

post.summary: Raises an emergency on today's trip of the caller's bus. The server adds the bus's latest position from its GPS device and the riders on board, sends sos.new to the Transportation office (and the clinic for medical and accident), and notifies the trip's students and guardians in calm words. The same Idempotency-Key never makes a second SOS (business rule 9). Errors: NOT_YOUR_TRIP (403), TRIP_ALREADY_ENDED (409).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.

get.summary: One SOS with its action log, for the crew member who raised it (or their bus's other crew member) to follow. Changes arrive on the WebSocket as sos.update; until then the app re-reads it every 5 s while it is open. Errors: NOT_FOUND (404).

Every SOS, newest first, with an optional `status` filter. The clinic gets only `medical` and `accident`. New alerts also arrive on the WebSocket as sos.new; until then the office pages re-read this every 5 s.
One SOS with its log, the trip's bus and driver now, the crew's phone and any bus or driver changes. Errors: NOT_FOUND (404, also for the clinic on a breakdown).

post.summary: Logs what the office did, with who and when (the log is never edited). `acknowledge` takes an open alert (the crew sees who took it); then `ambulance_called`, `note` (needs `note`) and `close` (needs the summary in `note`). Closing tells the trip's students and guardians it was handled. Errors: ALREADY_ACKNOWLEDGED, SOS_NOT_ACKNOWLEDGED, SOS_CLOSED (409), NOTE_REQUIRED (422).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.

get.summary: The trip's bus and driver now, how many riders it carries, and the buses (each with its driver) and drivers free to send today.

post.summary: Sends another bus (with its own driver, or `driver_id`) or only another driver to a trip that hasn't ended. Riders and attendance stay with the trip (business rule 10); the crew, the line's students and their guardians see the new bus and driver at once, and `sos_id` gets a `replacement_sent` line. Errors: TRIP_ALREADY_ENDED, BUS_NOT_AVAILABLE, DRIVER_NOT_AVAILABLE, SOS_CLOSED (409), NOTHING_TO_CHANGE (422).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.

post.summary: The crew records a breach of the bus Code of Conduct with a photo. It goes to Student Affairs and the Transportation office (admin violations page). Errors: STUDENT_NOT_FOUND (404), FILE_TYPE (422), FILE_TOO_LARGE (413).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.

get.summary: The violations this crew member recorded, newest first, with their status.

Receipts and Visa payments this term with the student, line and reviewer. Filter by `status` and search `q` (university ID, name or reference number). Waiting receipts come first, oldest first; `counts` holds the totals per status for the tabs.
One receipt with a short-lived `file_url` to the uploaded file and the student's other receipts this term. Errors: NOT_FOUND (404).

patch.summary: Approve or reject a waiting receipt. Approving activates the subscription (the card works at once); rejecting needs a `reason` the student sees and gives the seat a fresh 24-hour hold. The student gets a notification either way; logged in the audit log. Errors: PAYMENT_ALREADY_REVIEWED (409), REASON_REQUIRED (422), NOT_FOUND (404).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.

get.summary: At the cashier (A045): the booking of the student with this university ID, when it is waiting for a payment. Errors: STUDENT_NOT_FOUND (404), NOT_AWAITING_PAYMENT (409), HOLD_EXPIRED (409).

post.summary: Records a Visa payment taken at the Accounting office: approved at once, so the subscription is active. Errors: NOT_AWAITING_PAYMENT (409), HOLD_EXPIRED (409), RECEIPT_ALREADY_USED (409), AMOUNT_MISMATCH (422).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.

get.summary: The caller's office queue. Transportation: line changes (after the guardian approved), model permits and complaints except payment ones. Finance: refunds and payment complaints. Super admin: everything. Filter by `kind` (repeatable), `stage` (new / in_review / closed) and search `q` (university ID, name or request number). `counts` holds the totals per stage for the tabs.

One request with the student, what the caller may do now (`allowed_actions`), ready answers to start from and, for a line change, the free seats on the new line. Errors: NOT_FOUND (404, also for another office's request).

patch.summary: open (take it; optional note), approve / reject (line change, refund, model permit) or resolve (complaint). Reject and resolve need a `note`; approving an exceptional refund needs `refund_piasters`. Approving moves the student's line from the change's start date, or cancels the subscription for a refund. The student gets a notification; logged in the audit log. Errors: REQUEST_CLOSED, SEAT_UNAVAILABLE (409), NOTE_REQUIRED, ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED, REFUND_AMOUNT_INVALID (422), NOT_FOUND (404).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.

get.summary: Every violation the crews recorded, with the student, the reporter, the line and the decision. Filter by `status` and `rule`, search `q` (university ID or name). `counts` holds the totals per status for the tabs.
One violation with a short-lived `photo_url` and what the caller may do now. Errors: NOT_FOUND (404).

patch.summary: Student Affairs only: `open` it, or `close` it with an `outcome` (warning, investigation, dismissed) and a `note` for the file. The crew sees the status change; logged in the audit log. Errors: VIOLATION_CLOSED (409), DECISION_REQUIRED (422), FORBIDDEN (403 for the Transportation office).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.

get.summary: The report types the caller's role may open, with their titles.

The report on screen (`format=json`, paged with `page` / `page_size`) or as a download (`format=xlsx` or `pdf`: the file itself, with Content-Disposition "sutech_<type>_<line or all>_<from>_<to>.<ext>"). Same filter, same rows and numbers in every format. Money is in piasters in json and in pounds in the files; times are Egypt time. The PDF is Arabic RTL (or English, per Accept-Language) with the official logo, the filter and the time it was made. Without `from`/`to` the server uses this month so far (attendance: this week). Every export is written to the audit log. Errors: FORBIDDEN (403, a report the role may not see), INVALID_RANGE, REPORT_RANGE_TOO_LONG (attendance over 31 days), REPORT_TOO_LARGE_FOR_PDF (over 2,000 rows) (422), LINE_NOT_FOUND (404).
The Transportation office's event bus requests: waiting for Abu El Hol first, then the coming days, then the past. Filter by `status`; `counts` holds the totals per status.

post.summary: Ask Abu El Hol for buses for an event. The day must be from tomorrow up to 120 days ahead; the buses must seat the students. Errors: EVENT_DATE_INVALID, EVENT_TIMES_INVALID, NOT_ENOUGH_SEATS (422), EVENT_DUPLICATE (409).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.

get.summary: One event request with the company's answer. Errors: NOT_FOUND (404).

post.summary: Call the event off, with a reason Abu El Hol reads. Only while waiting or confirmed and before the day is over. Errors: EVENT_CLOSED (409), REASON_REQUIRED (422).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.

get.summary: Abu El Hol's view of the event requests, same order and counts as the office's list. No student data: only how many, when and where.
One request and the company's buses free that day (not sent to another event). Errors: NOT_FOUND (404).

post.summary: Confirm with 1 to `buses_requested` buses (each comes with its driver; fewer means a partial answer), or decline with a reason. Errors: EVENT_NOT_WAITING, BUS_NOT_AVAILABLE (409), BUSES_INVALID, REASON_REQUIRED (422).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.

get.summary: Abu El Hol's buses with their drivers: the line each runs, the spares at the garage, today's replacements and today's events.

One day at a glance, read-only: riding per line (subscribers, rode, not going, absent), the latest delay per line, that day's SOS alerts and event buses, and how many violation reports wait for Student Affairs. `date` defaults to today; up to 31 days back. Errors: DATE_INVALID (422).
The students this account follows and how each one's morning trip went that day (waiting, on the bus, arrived, left on the way, not going, absent). Errors: DATE_INVALID.

post.summary: Follow a student by university ID (at most 20). Answers today's list. Errors: STUDENT_NOT_FOUND (404), ALREADY_WATCHED, WATCHLIST_FULL (409).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.

delete.summary: Stop following a student. Answers today's list.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.
